objective: Wait, wait, you said your name was <name>?

<name>! I am so glad to finally meet you. Someone delivered a package here addressed to you and assured me that you would eventually come to pick it up. I tried to tell them that we don't do that around here, but before I could get a word in, they were already gone!
Your timing is great, too. It was gonna be lumped up with all the other garbage that I toss into the sea nightly.
What? We all do it. Ugh, just take your package and go!
